description: Calculate official SARS travel allowance tax pack totals for a vehicle across the South African tax year (1 March to 28/29 February), returning total km, business km, business %, and total fuel expenditure.

tax_year.description: Tax year starting year (e.g. 2026 for the 2026/2027 tax year starting 1 March 2026).
